download_dpr_resource: download a DPR resource like NQ train data or retriever checkpoint by its resource key
download_resource_single_file: download a single compressed or uncompressed DPR resource file from an S3 URL to a local directory
download_file_simple: download a single file from a URL to a specified output directory without decompression
unpack_gzip_file: unpack a gzip compressed file and save the decompressed contents to a specified output path
run_download_cli: run the DPR data download CLI tool with a resource key and optional output directory argument
